subject.title: [Feature]: Support fail-closed staged publication for Automations

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a generic durable staged-publication gate for Automations, with authorization policy remaining outside core, or keep this approval workflow host/plugin-owned?
rationale: The choice creates a public gateway and persisted-state contract across scheduler execution paths and defines a security boundary; repository evidence available to this review cannot establish that one direction is already approved or covered by an existing extension seam.

options.title: Sponsor a minimal generic gate
options.body: Define an opt-in core staged state and revision-fenced finalization API while keeping proof interpretation, signer choice, and approval policy in the host or plugin.

options.title: Keep approval orchestration outside core
options.body: Retain existing Automation lifecycle operations and direct governed hosts to implement approval before creating or enabling a normal Automation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a minimal generic gate
recommendation.body: Define an opt-in core staged state and revision-fenced finalization API while keeping proof interpretation, signer choice, and approval policy in the host or plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue directly requests this person's confirmation for the proposed cross-cutting Automation contract.
